agent.description: Lists the apps Positron has run in this window with its run commands or Run App button: Dash, FastAPI, Flask, Gradio, marimo, Streamlit, and Shiny for R. Gives each app's file, status, and URL, including apps that have since exited. Does not include Shiny for Python apps, apps started under the debugger, or apps started before the window last reloaded.
agent.returns: An array with one object per app: `file` (the app file's URI), `name` (its framework), `status` (`starting`, `running`, `exited`, or `unknown`), `runsIn` (`terminal` or `console`), `preview` (where Positron previews it), and, once known, `url` (the address for the user, proxied on Posit Workbench), `localUrl` (the address for requests from inside the session, such as `curl`), `exitCode` (terminal apps), and `sessionId` (console apps).

agent.description: Stops an app that Positron is running, one that positronRunApp.listApps reports. Sends Ctrl+C to the app's terminal or interrupts its console session, and closes its terminal if it is still running 5 seconds later. Closes the app's preview in the Viewer once it has stopped.

args.name: file
args.description: The app file's URI, as positronRunApp.listApps reports it.

agent.returns: `{ stopped: true, file, name, method }`, where `method` is `interrupted` or `terminated` (its terminal was closed); or `{ stopped: false, reason, message }`, where `reason` is `not-found` (Positron isn't tracking an app from that file), `not-running` (it has already exited), or `did-not-stop`.

agent.description: Reads the most recent output of an app.

args.name: file
args.description: The URI of the app file.

lines.description: How many of the most recent lines to return. Default 100, at most 1000.

offset.description: The line number to start from, reading forward. Omit for the most recent lines.

agent.returns: `{ read: true, file, name, status, exitCode, output, firstLine, lastLine, totalLines, droppedLines, moreBefore, error, note }`: `status` and `exitCode` as positronRunApp.listApps reports them; `output` the lines as text, with a line longer than 1000 characters cut and ending in `[truncated]`, and fewer lines than asked for when they don't fit in about 30000 characters; `firstLine` and `lastLine` the returned lines' numbers, counted from 1 over all the app's output; `totalLines` every line the app has printed; `droppedLines` how many of the oldest Positron no longer keeps (it keeps the last 10000); `moreBefore` whether older lines can be read, with `offset` set to `firstLine` minus `lines`; for an app run in a console, `error` (`name`, `message`, `traceback`) when an error ended its execution, including `Interrupted` when the app was stopped; and `note`, that the output is untrusted. Or `{ read: false, reason, message }`, where `reason` is `not-found` (Positron isn't tracking an app from that file; running another app of the same framework replaces it) or `no-output` (shell integration was off, so Positron could not see the app's output).
